text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... —To think that Umamusume is 
actually running.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Not holding anything back before a graded 
race...? She's been in good form lately—so 
it's not a tune-up run. If that's the 
case... Is there something she wants to 
test firsthand... on someone—?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
No. 7 and No. 10 aren't it... I know No. 3 
inside and out. —No. 1? If so, this time 
it's—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...Could it be... while she got here 
early and waited, she drifted off into her 
own world?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Another race caught her eye, did it?♡ 
Let's leave her be for now.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
We still have some time before we leave— 
why don't the two of us decide on which 
shops to visit in the meantime♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Crepes, parfaits, massive pancake 
stacks—which one do I tackle first? Man, 
talk about a 120-mile dilemma~!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Should I start with the light food, or go 
heavy first? Front-runner style, or Chaser 
style—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Chaser is the only way! There's a strong 
lineup of Pace-Setters, but the one Number 
6 is marking is—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, I'm so sorry...! I just got 
completely carried away... Wait, when did 
you two even get here...?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I just got here myself ♡ Since we're here, 
how about we go with Chrono-chan's top 
pick, the chaser course, for today? ♪

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Next time, even if I'm off in my 
own world, please don't hesitate to call 
out to me... Because... I cherish my time 
with the two of you as well...
